Status: wave 343: the en table's reader lambdas named Read<Property>, correcting two wave-341 mislabels

Method.evidence: A table entry can reference two <>c lambdas: the raw reader (Func<byte[],Class430,object>) and the display formatter (Func<object,Class430,IDataProvider,IDictionary<ResourceName,byte[]>,string>). Wave 341 classified by property uniqueness, which mislabelled the two properties whose only lambda is a reader: 0x060000F4 was FormatFriendlyName and is now ReadFriendlyName, 0x0600010C was FormatSecurityMode and is now ReadSecurityMode. All 16 readers are named Read<Property> from their property entry in en::.cctor.
Method.themes: Lesson recorded: classify a <>c reference by its signature shape before naming it - reader vs formatter - which is what perf-now/en-classify.py does (16 readers, 36 formatters, 0 other across the en table). Then corrects are cheap and provable by map diff.
